- One of: corporate resolution, board minutes excerpt, or signed letter on company letterhead confirming signatory authority
- Confirmation whether your EDI/ERP integrator (vendor) is permitted to sign on behalf of ZenPharm; if yes, provide their name and MSA
- If you plan to use an API/EDI channel for PO-ack, confirm the technical contact and preferred acknowledgement window (24/48/72 hrs)

I've attached a one-page evidence checklist to make this quick. If you prefer, we can accept a Docusign attestation and a PDF of the corporate resolution.

Next steps: if you can get the attestation + one evidence item to us by EOD Tue (US PT), we will:
- Apply a small Order Form amendment to include the signatory-attestation clause
- Flip PO-ack to active on the portal (Coupa) and confirm the ack window

If anything is unclear I can hop on a 20-min call with your procurement lead.
